answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent locks 200 POA, and its activity signal must echo completed work, verified on-chain, not self-reported. If the slot idles or the signal proves faked, the deposit burns. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, all lost; like cracking a walnut, each shell costs real effort. Honest agents pay once, keep the slot, and earn undiluted, so honesty beats faking.
